            <label htmlFor="invoice-amount">Invoice Amount</label>

              type="button"
              className="filter-remove-btn"
              onClick={() => handleRemoveFilter(filterId)}
              aria-label="Remove invoice amount filter"
            >
              ×
            </button>
            <div className="filter-row">
              <input
                id="invoice-amount"
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                min="0"
                value={filters.invoiceAmount}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('invoiceAmount', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="0.00"
              />
              <select
                value={filters.invoiceAmountOperator}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('invoiceAmountOperator', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="Greater Than">Greater Than</option>
                <option value="Less Than">Less Than</option>
                <option value="Equal To">Equal To</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 'paymentStatus':
        return (
          <div className="filter-group" key={filterId}>
            <label htmlFor="payment-status">Payment Status</label>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="filter-remove-btn"
              onClick={() => handleRemoveFilter(filterId)}
              aria-label="Remove payment status filter"
            >
              ×
            </button>
            <select
              id="payment-status"
              value={filters.paymentStatus}
              onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('paymentStatus', e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">All Statuses</option>
              <option value="Paid">Paid</option>
              <option value="Pending">Pending</option>
              <option value="Loss">Loss</option>
              <option value="Not Paid">Not Paid</option>
              <option value="Not Pending">Not Pending</option>
              <option value="Not Loss">Not Loss</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        );

      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Overlay */}
      <div
        className="filter-panel-overlay"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* Panel Content */}
      <div className={`filter-panel-content ${isOpen ? 'open' : 'closed'}`}>
        <div className="filter-panel-header">
          <button
            className="filter-panel-close"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close filter panel"
          >
            ×
          </button>
          <h2>Filter Invoices</h2>
        </div>
        <div className="filter-panel-body">
          <form onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
            {/* Filter Addition Controls */}
            {availableFilters.length > 0 && (
              <div className="filter-add-controls">
                <select
                  value={selectedFilterToAdd}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedFilterToAdd(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-select"
                >
                  <option value="">Select a filter...</option>
                  {availableFilters.map(filter => (
                    <option key={filter.id} value={filter.id}>
                      {filter.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn-add-filter"
                  onClick={handleAddFilter}
                  disabled={!selectedFilterToAdd}
                >
                  +
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Active Filters */}
            {activeFilters.map(filterId => renderFilterControl(filterId))}

            {/* Action Buttons */}
            <div className="filter-actions">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn-secondary"
                onClick={handleClearFilters}
              >
                Clear Filters
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn-primary"
                onClick={handleApplyFilters}
              >
                Apply Filters
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export const invoiceApi = {
  async getAll() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices`);

        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async getByCustomer(customerId) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/customer/${customerId}`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching customer invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async create(invoice) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(invoice),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async fetchFilteredInvoices(filters) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/filter`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(filters),

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching filtered invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async update(invoiceNumber, invoice) {

      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/${invoiceNumber}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',

        body: JSON.stringify(invoice),

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
};

        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating payment:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async update(paymentId, payment) {

        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

export default function InvoiceFilterPanel({ isOpen, onClose, onApplyFilters }) {

      backendFilters.customer_id = filters.customer;

      // Convert YYYY-MM to date (first day of month)
      backendFilters.invoice_month_date = filters.invoiceMonth + '-01';
      // Map operator to backend format
      const operatorMap = {
        'On': '==',
        'Before': '<',
        'After': '>'
      };
      backendFilters.invoice_month_operator = operatorMap[filters.invoiceMonthOperator] || '==';
    }

    if (activeFilters.includes('paymentDate') && filters.paymentDate) {
      // Convert YYYY-MM to date (first day of month)
      backendFilters.payment_date = filters.paymentDate + '-01';
      // Map operator to backend format
      const operatorMap = {
        'On': '==',
        'Before': '<',
        'After': '>'
      };
      backendFilters.payment_date_operator = operatorMap[filters.paymentDateOperator] || '==';

      const operatorMap = {
        'Greater Than': '>',
        'Less Than': '<',
        'Equal To': '=='
      };
      backendFilters.invoice_amount_operator = operatorMap[filters.invoiceAmountOperator] || '==';

        'Paid': { payment_status_is_paid: true },

        'Loss': { payment_status_is_loss: true },
        'Not Paid': { payment_status_not_paid: true },

        'Not Loss': { payment_status_not_loss: true }

      Object.assign(backendFilters, statusMap[filters.paymentStatus] || {});

    onApplyFilters(backendFilters);
    onClose();

        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );

      const customers = await customerApi.getAll();
      const customerMap = {};
      customers.forEach(customer => {
        customerMap[customer.customer_id] = customer.name;
      });

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice and combine the data
      const invoicesWithDetails = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
          return {
            ...invoice,
            customer_name: customerMap[invoice.customer_id] || 'Unknown Customer',
            payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null,
            payment_status: payment?.payment_status || 'pending',
            payment_date: payment?.payment_date || null
          };
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithDetails);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      setError('Failed to load invoices. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

import { invoiceApi, customerApi, paymentApi } from '../services/api';
import InvoiceModal from '../components/InvoiceModal';
import InvoiceFilterPanel from '../components/InvoiceFilterPanel';

const Invoices = () => {
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [isInvoiceModalOpen, setIsInvoiceModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCustomerSelectOpen, setIsCustomerSelectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCustomerId, setSelectedCustomerId] = useState(null);
  const [isFilterPanelOpen, setIsFilterPanelOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeFilters, setActiveFilters] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAllInvoices();
    loadCustomers();
  }, [activeFilters]);

  const loadAllInvoices = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      // Fetch invoices based on whether filters are active
      const invoiceList = Object.keys(activeFilters).length === 0
        ? await invoiceApi.getAll()
        : await invoiceApi.fetchFilteredInvoices(activeFilters);

      // Fetch all customers to create a mapping of customer_id to customer_name
      const customers = await customerApi.getAll();
      const customerMap = {};
      customers.forEach(customer => {
        customerMap[customer.customer_id] = customer.name;
      });

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice and combine the data
      const invoicesWithDetails = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
          return {
            ...invoice,
            customer_name: customerMap[invoice.customer_id] || 'Unknown Customer',
            payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null,
            payment_status: payment?.payment_status || 'pending',
            payment_date: payment?.payment_date || null
          };
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithDetails);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      setError('Failed to load invoices. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const loadCustomers = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await customerApi.getAll();
      setCustomers(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading customers:', err);
    }
  };

  const getPaymentStatusStyle = (status) => {
    const styles = {
      paid: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
      pending: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-400',
      loss: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
    };
    return styles[status?.toLowerCase()] || styles.pending;
  };

  const handleAddInvoice = async (invoiceData) => {
    try {
      await invoiceApi.create(invoiceData);
      await loadAllInvoices(); // Refresh the list
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const handleOpenInvoiceModal = () => {
    setIsCustomerSelectOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCustomerSelect = (customerId) => {
    setSelectedCustomerId(customerId);
    setIsCustomerSelectOpen(false);
    setIsInvoiceModalOpen(true);
  };

  const getActiveFilterLabels = () => {
    const labels = [];

    if (activeFilters.customer_id) {
      const customer = customers.find(c => c.customer_id === activeFilters.customer_id);
      if (customer) {
        labels.push(`Customer: ${customer.name}`);
      }
    }

    if (activeFilters.invoice_month_date) {
      const date = new Date(activeFilters.invoice_month_date);
      const monthYear = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const operator = activeFilters.invoice_month_operator === '==' ? '' :
                       activeFilters.invoice_month_operator === '>' ? 'After ' : 'Before ';
      labels.push(`Invoice Month: ${operator}${monthYear}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.payment_date) {
      const date = new Date(activeFilters.payment_date);
      const monthYear = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const operator = activeFilters.payment_date_operator === '==' ? '' :
                       activeFilters.payment_date_operator === '>' ? 'After ' : 'Before ';
      labels.push(`Payment Date: ${operator}${monthYear}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.invoice_amount !== undefined) {
      const operator = activeFilters.invoice_amount_operator === '==' ? 'Equal to ' :
                       activeFilters.invoice_amount_operator === '>' ? 'Greater than ' : 'Less than ';
      labels.push(`Amount: ${operator}$${activeFilters.invoice_amount}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_paid) labels.push('Status: Paid');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_pending) labels.push('Status: Pending');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_loss) labels.push('Status: Loss');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_paid) labels.push('Status: Not Paid');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_pending) labels.push('Status: Not Pending');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_loss) labels.push('Status: Not Loss');

    return labels;
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setActiveFilters({});
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pt-2 pr-4 shrink-0">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Invoice Management</h2>
          <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">Manage and track your customer invoices.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="relative hidden sm:block">
            <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400 text-sm">search</span>
            </span>
            <input className="pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-full border-none bg-white dark:bg-card-dark shadow-sm text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary w-64 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200" placeholder="Search invoices..." type="text"/>
          </div>
          <button className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-card-dark rounded-full shadow-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary transition-colors relative">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined">notifications</span>
            <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-2 h-2 bg-red-500 rounded-full"></span>
          </button>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-300 overflow-hidden border-2 border-white dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm">
            <img alt="Profile" className="w-full h-full object-cover" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDPthKT8vmwawHExPW3xkBr-Ql6dfwnZR4_mFxsnVAjligDy0HZmjlI_EV-6IR8LtrU9h1Anhfe_yjtxhxsP8iUq9db89yZ5Pq2imJmV-sIbuq_LnEYOPMk5pDIFN3WP7SM9uylJqgphz4M4_juqc-v-CYYoEznshFJ9xeahK1GBrWt7ixGnn6jlRX60xTfo8d-nZFuPZkL-uhzPtJDurY2Y0pIHSEwflCB-GWYno-Rr9_WhOwAb3jXp7DvQzcyxmPoUbXTEPys0UU"/>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div className="bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex flex-col flex-1 overflow-hidden pr-4">
        <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
            <div className="p-2 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 rounded-xl text-primary">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-2xl">receipt</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">All Invoices</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Total {invoices.length} invoices</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleOpenInvoiceModal}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-primary hover:bg-sky-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-lg">add</span>
            Add Invoice
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-auto flex-1">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            <thead className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-sm">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Invoice Number</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Base Price</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">QST (9.975%)</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">GST (5%)</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Payment Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Payment Date</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    Loading invoices...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : error ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8">
                    <div className="text-center">
                      <p className="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</p>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : invoices.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    No invoices found.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                invoices.map((invoice, index) => (
                  <tr key={invoice.invoice_number} className={`${index % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-900' : 'bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50'} hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors`}>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{invoice.invoice_number}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
                          {invoice.customer_name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').toUpperCase().substring(0, 2)}
                        </div>
                        <span>{invoice.customer_name}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-900 dark:text-white font-medium">{formatCurrency(invoice.base_price)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatCurrency(invoice.qst)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatCurrency(invoice.gst)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold capitalize ${getPaymentStatusStyle(invoice.payment_status)}`}>
                        {invoice.payment_status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatDate(invoice.payment_date)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <button className="text-gray-400 hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        <span className="material-icons-outlined">more_vert</span>
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            Showing <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">1</span> to <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{invoices.length}</span> of <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{invoices.length}</span> results
          </div>
          <nav className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors" disabled="">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">chevron_left</span>
            </button>
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-white font-medium text-sm transition-colors">1</button>
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 font-medium text-sm transition-colors">2</button>
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 font-medium text-sm transition-colors">3</button>
            <span className="text-gray-400">...</span>
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 font-medium text-sm transition-colors">10</button>
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">chevron_right</span>
            </button>
          </nav>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Customer Selection Modal */}
      {isCustomerSelectOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4"
          onClick={() => setIsCustomerSelectOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            className="bg-white dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 bg-primary/10 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="material-icons-outlined text-primary">person</span>
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Select Customer</h2>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsCustomerSelectOpen(false)}
                className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl transition-colors"
              >
                <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">close</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh]">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {customers.map((customer) => (
                  <button
                    key={customer.customer_id}
                    onClick={() => handleCustomerSelect(customer.customer_id)}
                    className="w-full p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-xl text-left transition-colors flex items-center gap-3"
                  >
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                      {customer.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').toUpperCase().substring(0, 2)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{customer.email || customer.phone || 'No contact info'}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">chevron_right</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <InvoiceModal
        isOpen={isInvoiceModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsInvoiceModalOpen(false);
          setSelectedCustomerId(null);
        }}
        onSave={handleAddInvoice}
        customerId={selectedCustomerId}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Invoices;

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAllInvoices();
    loadCustomers();
  }, [activeFilters]);

  const loadAllInvoices = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      // Fetch invoices based on whether filters are active
      const invoiceList = Object.keys(activeFilters).length === 0
        ? await invoiceApi.getAll()
        : await invoiceApi.fetchFilteredInvoices(activeFilters);

      // Fetch all customers to create a mapping of customer_id to customer_name
      const customers = await customerApi.getAll();
      const customerMap = {};
      customers.forEach(customer => {
        customerMap[customer.customer_id] = customer.name;
      });

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice and combine the data
      const invoicesWithDetails = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
          return {
            ...invoice,
            customer_name: customerMap[invoice.customer_id] || 'Unknown Customer',
            payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null,
            payment_status: payment?.payment_status || 'pending',
            payment_date: payment?.payment_date || null
          };
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithDetails);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      setError('Failed to load invoices. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const loadCustomers = async () => {

      const data = await customerApi.getAll();
      setCustomers(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading customers:', err);
    }
  };

  const getPaymentStatusStyle = (status) => {
    const styles = {

      pending: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-400',
      loss: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
    };
    return styles[status?.toLowerCase()] || styles.pending;
  };

      if (customer) {
        labels.push(`Customer: ${customer.name}`);
      }
    }

    if (activeFilters.invoice_month_date) {
      const date = new Date(activeFilters.invoice_month_date);
      const monthYear = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const operator = activeFilters.invoice_month_operator === '==' ? '' :
                       activeFilters.invoice_month_operator === '>' ? 'After ' : 'Before ';
      labels.push(`Invoice Month: ${operator}${monthYear}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.payment_date) {
      const date = new Date(activeFilters.payment_date);
      const monthYear = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const operator = activeFilters.payment_date_operator === '==' ? '' :
                       activeFilters.payment_date_operator === '>' ? 'After ' : 'Before ';

    if (activeFilters.invoice_amount !== undefined) {

      labels.push(`Amount: ${operator}$${activeFilters.invoice_amount}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_paid) labels.push('Status: Paid');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_pending) labels.push('Status: Pending');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_loss) labels.push('Status: Loss');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_paid) labels.push('Status: Not Paid');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_pending) labels.push('Status: Not Pending');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_loss) labels.push('Status: Not Loss');

    return labels;
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setActiveFilters({});
  };

              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-2xl">receipt</span>

import InvoiceFilterPanel from '../components/InvoiceFilterPanel';

const Invoices = () => {
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [isInvoiceModalOpen, setIsInvoiceModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCustomerSelectOpen, setIsCustomerSelectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCustomerId, setSelectedCustomerId] = useState(null);
  const [isFilterPanelOpen, setIsFilterPanelOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeFilters, setActiveFilters] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAllInvoices();
    loadCustomers();
  }, [activeFilters]);

  const loadAllInvoices = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      // Fetch invoices based on whether filters are active
      const invoiceList = Object.keys(activeFilters).length === 0
        ? await invoiceApi.getAll()
        : await invoiceApi.fetchFilteredInvoices(activeFilters);

      // Fetch all customers to create a mapping of customer_id to customer_name
      const customers = await customerApi.getAll();
      const customerMap = {};
      customers.forEach(customer => {
        customerMap[customer.customer_id] = customer.name;
      });

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice and combine the data
      const invoicesWithDetails = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
          return {
            ...invoice,
            customer_name: customerMap[invoice.customer_id] || 'Unknown Customer',
            payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null,
            payment_status: payment?.payment_status || 'pending',
            payment_date: payment?.payment_date || null
          };
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithDetails);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      setError('Failed to load invoices. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const loadCustomers = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await customerApi.getAll();
      setCustomers(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading customers:', err);
    }
  };

  const getPaymentStatusStyle = (status) => {
    const styles = {
      paid: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
      pending: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-400',
      loss: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
    };
    return styles[status?.toLowerCase()] || styles.pending;
  };

  const handleAddInvoice = async (invoiceData) => {
    try {
      await invoiceApi.create(invoiceData);
      await loadAllInvoices(); // Refresh the list
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const handleOpenInvoiceModal = () => {
    setIsCustomerSelectOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCustomerSelect = (customerId) => {
    setSelectedCustomerId(customerId);
    setIsCustomerSelectOpen(false);
    setIsInvoiceModalOpen(true);
  };

  const getActiveFilterLabels = () => {
    const labels = [];

    if (activeFilters.customer_id) {
      const customer = customers.find(c => c.customer_id === activeFilters.customer_id);
      if (customer) {
        labels.push(`Customer: ${customer.name}`);
      }
    }

    if (activeFilters.invoice_month_date) {
      const date = new Date(activeFilters.invoice_month_date);
      const monthYear = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const operator = activeFilters.invoice_month_operator === '==' ? '' :
                       activeFilters.invoice_month_operator === '>' ? 'After ' : 'Before ';
      labels.push(`Invoice Month: ${operator}${monthYear}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.payment_date) {
      const date = new Date(activeFilters.payment_date);
      const monthYear = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const operator = activeFilters.payment_date_operator === '==' ? '' :
                       activeFilters.payment_date_operator === '>' ? 'After ' : 'Before ';
      labels.push(`Payment Date: ${operator}${monthYear}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.invoice_amount !== undefined) {
      const operator = activeFilters.invoice_amount_operator === '==' ? 'Equal to ' :
                       activeFilters.invoice_amount_operator === '>' ? 'Greater than ' : 'Less than ';
      labels.push(`Amount: ${operator}$${activeFilters.invoice_amount}`);
    }

    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_paid) labels.push('Status: Paid');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_pending) labels.push('Status: Pending');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_is_loss) labels.push('Status: Loss');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_paid) labels.push('Status: Not Paid');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_pending) labels.push('Status: Not Pending');
    if (activeFilters.payment_status_not_loss) labels.push('Status: Not Loss');

    return labels;
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setActiveFilters({});
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pt-2 pr-4 shrink-0">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Invoice Management</h2>
          <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">Manage and track your customer invoices.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="relative hidden sm:block">
            <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400 text-sm">search</span>
            </span>
            <input className="pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-full border-none bg-white dark:bg-card-dark shadow-sm text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary w-64 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200" placeholder="Search invoices..." type="text"/>
          </div>
          <button className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-card-dark rounded-full shadow-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary transition-colors relative">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined">notifications</span>
            <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-2 h-2 bg-red-500 rounded-full"></span>
          </button>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-300 overflow-hidden border-2 border-white dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm">
            <img alt="Profile" className="w-full h-full object-cover" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDPthKT8vmwawHExPW3xkBr-Ql6dfwnZR4_mFxsnVAjligDy0HZmjlI_EV-6IR8LtrU9h1Anhfe_yjtxhxsP8iUq9db89yZ5Pq2imJmV-sIbuq_LnEYOPMk5pDIFN3WP7SM9uylJqgphz4M4_juqc-v-CYYoEznshFJ9xeahK1GBrWt7ixGnn6jlRX60xTfo8d-nZFuPZkL-uhzPtJDurY2Y0pIHSEwflCB-GWYno-Rr9_WhOwAb3jXp7DvQzcyxmPoUbXTEPys0UU"/>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div className="bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex flex-col flex-1 overflow-hidden pr-4">
        <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
            <div className="p-2 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 rounded-xl text-primary">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-2xl">receipt</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">All Invoices</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Total {invoices.length} invoices</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsFilterPanelOpen(true)}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 font-medium rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-2 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
            >
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-lg">filter_list</span>
              Filter
              {Object.keys(activeFilters).length > 0 && (
                <span className="ml-1 px-2 py-0.5 bg-primary text-white text-xs rounded-full">
                  {Object.keys(activeFilters).length}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleOpenInvoiceModal}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-primary hover:bg-sky-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-lg">add</span>
              Add Invoice
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Active Filters Bar */}
        {Object.keys(activeFilters).length > 0 && (
          <div className="px-6 py-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap flex-1">

                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleClearFilters}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-base">clear</span>
              Clear All
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="overflow-auto flex-1">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            <thead className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-sm">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Invoice Number</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Base Price</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">QST (9.975%)</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">GST (5%)</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Payment Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Payment Date</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    Loading invoices...
                  </td>

## Confirmation and Changelog

Phase 4 - Task 5 has been **successfully completed**. The invoice filtering functionality has been fully ported from the old UI to the new Jules UI.

### Changes Made:

#### 1. Created `/workspace/projects/window-cleaning/jules-ui/src/components/InvoiceFilterPanel.jsx`
   - A new component that provides a slide-in panel from the right side
   - Styled to match the new UI's glassmorphism design system using Tailwind CSS
   - Supports 5 filter types:
     - **Customer**: Dropdown to filter by specific customer
     - **Invoice Month**: Month picker with operator (On/Before/After)
     - **Payment Date**: Month picker with operator (On/Before/After)
     - **Invoice Amount**: Number input with operator (Equal To/Greater Than/Less Than)
     - **Payment Status**: Dropdown with 6 options (Paid, Pending, Loss, Not Paid, Not Pending, Not Loss)
   - Features dynamic filter addition/removal
   - Transforms frontend filter values to backend API format
   - Includes "Clear All" and "Apply Filters" action buttons

#### 2. Updated `/workspace/projects/window-cleaning/jules-ui/src/pages/Invoices.jsx`
   - Added import for `InvoiceFilterPanel` component
   - Added state management:
     - `isFilterPanelOpen`: Controls filter panel visibility
     - `activeFilters`: Stores currently active filter criteria
   - Modified `useEffect` to re-fetch invoices when filters change
   - Updated `loadAllInvoices()` to conditionally use filtered or unfiltered API calls
   - Added `getActiveFilterLabels()` helper function to display filter tags
   - Added `handleClearFilters()` function to reset all filters
   - UI Enhancements:
     - Added "Filter" button next to "Add Invoice" button with filter count badge
     - Added active filters bar (appears when filters are active) showing filter tags
     - Integrated `InvoiceFilterPanel` component with proper state handlers

### Features Implemented:
- **Dynamic filter panel** that slides in from the right
- **Filter count badge** on the Filter button showing number of active filters
- **Active filters display bar** with visual tags for each active filter
- **Real-time filtering** that fetches data from backend API
- **Clear all filters** functionality
- **Consistent design** matching the new UI's aesthetic (rounded corners, shadows, dark mode support)

All functionality from the old Invoice filtering system has been successfully ported while maintaining consistency with the Jules UI design system.
